status: measured. The three gates and the relabelling control PASS. The one preregistered prediction that could fail, P3, DOES NOT HOLD: it is true at 300 steps and false at 900, so it is a budget artifact and is not established. The Lebesgue carrier is sound and, on this testbed, does not separate what the entropy scalar merges.
subject: manifests/qsigma_r1x_spectral_measure_preregistration.json
governing_protocol: the preregistration frozen at 1b55ce0, before src/aionq/lebesgue.py or tests/test_lebesgue.py existed

gates.G1_entropy_is_the_integral: PASS. measure_entropy(spectral_measure(Gamma, A)) equals supercable.covariance_entropy(Gamma, A) to 1e-12 on every split at 4, 6 and 8 qubits, and on all 42 sweep rows.
gates.G2_vacuum: PASS. mu_A = delta_1 on unions of Majorana pairs; mu_A = delta_0 on {0, 2}, two modes from different pairs, which carries a full bit inside a globally pure state.
gates.G3_frame_invariance: PASS to 1e-12 under permutation and under orthogonal mixing inside the block. SEMANTIC, as declared: this restates similarity invariance of a spectrum and is a control, not a result.
gates.P2_the_R1Q_attack: PASS. D and w do not move under relabelling; the domain-side crossing count moves for the same permutations. The carrier is immune to the artifact class that killed R1Q's rule -- for free, which is the point, not to its credit.

P3.prediction: at least one pair of ladder cells, at matched seed, with |Delta S| < 0.05 bits and |Delta D| > 0.10
P3.at_300_steps: TRUE. Two hits of 63 matched-seed pairs, both at seed 7: M15 against T16 and M15 against AGL, entropy gap 3.2e-13 and defect gap 0.250.
P3.at_900_steps: FALSE. Zero hits of 63. At every matched seed, cells that share an entropy also share a defect.
P3.verdict: NOT ESTABLISHED. Two hits generated by a single state, absent at a longer budget. R1O already recorded a budget artifact in this line and the check was to run both budgets rather than to trust one.
P3.the_protocol_defect_this_exposes: The preregistration froze the two thresholds -- 0.05 bits and 0.10 W1 -- and wrote 'fixed step budget' without fixing it. A free parameter left in a frozen protocol is a threshold in disguise: 300 and 900 give opposite answers to the same preregistered question, and either could have been reported alone as the result. Both are reported. Same shape as every other defect in this ledger -- a guard whose witness cannot reach the case it asserts.
P3.what_was_not_done: The entropy window was not widened, the defect floor was not narrowed, the split was not moved, the ladder was not changed, and the 900-step rows were not dropped. There is a within-cell observation at 900 -- the same rung at different seeds reaching the same entropy with different defects -- which is NOT P3, was not preregistered, and is not counted.

what_is_established: mu_A is the measure the entropy of this line has been integrating since R1J, verified against the existing implementation on two independent code paths.

The Lebesgue weight w -- the mass at the purity atom -- is a graded collapse coordinate where final_entropy is a scalar summary. It is reported for all 42 rows and is not the subject of a preregistered prediction.

The reconstruction defect D has the three properties R1S's interaction ratio lacked: bounded in [0,1], no sign to reverse, exactly zero at reconstruction. It MEASURES the additivity failure R1S found; it does not repair it.

T16 and AGL produce byte-identical rows at both budgets and all three seeds, consistent with R1N's finding that they are the same herald family. A consistency check, not a discovery: the repository already knew.
what_is_not_claimed: not that partitioning the range beats partitioning the domain. On this testbed it does not, and P3 is how that was put at risk.
not that frame invariance is a finding of this round; it is linear algebra and was preregistered as a control.
not that mu_A is physical or observable.
not independent witnessing: producer and verifier are the same development line.
not cross-platform reproduction: no job has run on another platform for this round.
evidence_tag: MEASURED for the finite statement about this 8-qubit testbed; SEMANTIC for G3 and P2.
environment: Python 3, NumPy, SciPy; local container; no CI job was run for this round and none is claimed.
typed_remainders: [R]_gaussian: the construction assumes a Gaussian state. Measured to hold for the R1J-R1R line, not assumed; a quartic term takes mu_A with it.
[R]_finite: at finite m every measure is atomic, so the split at the purity atom is well defined and the absolutely-continuous versus singular decomposition is NOT available and is not used.
[R]_budget: P3's answer depends on a parameter the protocol left free. Any future round asking this question must freeze the budget before running.

result.observed: gates pass; P3 not established, budget-dependent

supersession.amended_clause: P3.verdict and P3.the_protocol_defect_this_exposes. Both stated facts that stand -- P3 is true at 300 steps and false at 900, and the budget was left free -- but the CAUSE attributed to the flip was wrong.
supersession.the_correction: The budget was never the mechanism. 81 of the 84 symplectic semi-axes across the entire sweep sit exactly at 0 or 1, IDENTICALLY at both budgets, and only M3 carries intermediate values. A measure supported on {0,1} has exactly one degree of freedom -- the weight w -- so mu_A could not carry more information than the scalar it was meant to beat, for six of the seven cells, at any budget. P3 was structurally unable to succeed and the round did not check that before running. The 300-step hits were combinatorial, counting how many pure axes the whole has against the parts, not geometric.
supersession.what_still_governs: the three gates, the relabelling control, the forbidden promotions, the evidence ceiling, and the finding that D is bounded, sign-free and zero at reconstruction. None of that depended on P3.
